# Cedar County Winter Preparedness Brief

The Cedar County warming center opens at 6:00 p.m. when the forecast is 10 degrees Fahrenheit or colder. The center is located at 245 North Pine Street.

Residents should bring identification, required medicines, and one change of clothing. Pets are accepted in carriers. The county information line is 555-0142.

The backup generator is tested every Tuesday at 9:00 a.m. and has fuel for approximately 36 hours at normal load.
